methodology: A browser was used to view selected public-player moments on What Ships. These notes cover selected moments only, without full-runtime inspection, source-frame hashes, precise shot boundaries, measured camera/lighting changes, or permission to reuse media. Hypotheses are separated from things visible on screen.

visibleMoments: A six-row demonstration shows differently shaped easing curves and colored dots on tracks.
Oversized repeated black NEVER lettering fills a fluorescent yellow composition.
An orange-coral end card pairs a bold Claude wordmark with a floral mark and serif subline.
techniqueHypotheses: Try moving visual explanations of easing, followed by a tightly restricted high-contrast typographic reveal.

visibleMoments: An editor-like window combines source text, layer controls, a timeline and rendered lettering.
Another visible moment shows overlapping typographic sheets folding or sliding through a three-dimensional-looking composition.
techniqueHypotheses: Prototype layered paper/card transforms driven by a reusable compositing timeline.

visibleMoments: A dark, softly lit vintage computer is shown against a black backdrop with short white text.
Another sampled moment shows a person working on electronics at a cluttered bench.
A white screen displays a thin black patent-style drawing of a device.
techniqueHypotheses: Study transitions between atmospheric scenes, documentary footage and sparse technical diagrams.

visibleMoments: A sampled end frame shows a near-black round face with two long white eye shapes on a pale gray background.
techniqueHypotheses: The site's description suggests icon morphs, but an end-frame sighting cannot verify those transitions.

visibleMoments: One sampled composition shows a translucent, refractive sphere-like form over Liquid lettering in a design-interface context.
techniqueHypotheses: Test original refractive-logo overlays inside an otherwise readable product UI composition.

visibleMoments: An orange dune image carries a sparse white headline.
A purple-to-cyan chart-like screen is followed by a pale gradient prompt interface.
A later output image contains a blue chair on reflective pink terrain.
techniqueHypotheses: Test a visual sequence of atmosphere, claimed proof, input interaction and visually distinctive result; independently verify any chart claims.

visibleMoments: A globe behind oversized white type introduces the product.
An aerial city-and-tram image precedes a prompt card asking for a 3D model.
A later shot displays a yellow tram model in a Blender-style modeling viewport.
techniqueHypotheses: Test connecting cinematic subject context to a concrete application demonstration without inferring that the film verifies the advertised capability.

visibleMoments: Two people sit in chairs in front of a screen displaying changing text.
A presenter speaks toward the camera in an office while captions appear near the lower edge.
Other moments show people using computers in a shared workspace.
techniqueHypotheses: Compare real-people demonstrations against fully animated explanations for unfamiliar hardware concepts.

visibleMoments: A terminal transcript sits beside a small Tokyo travel-planning app with checklist controls.
Another visible moment shows multiple desktop windows and labeled colored cursors performing app interactions.
A native context menu appears during a later screen-recording segment.
techniqueHypotheses: Test labeled parallel cursors and unobstructed app feedback as a direct capability demonstration.
